title: CAVATAPPI WITH SAUSAGE AND PEAS
content: CAVATAPPI WITH SAUSAGE AND PEAS info About 5 minutes prep, 30 minutes total about 4 servings ingredients 1 tablespoon olive oil 1 small yellow onion, diced 1 small red bell pepper, diced 2 mild italian sausages, casing removed 3 cloves garlic, minced 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper 1 pound cavatappi pasta 1 tablespoon salt 64 oz water 4.5 6 quart pot with lid 1 jar quality pasta sauce (Rao's) 1/2 cup frozen peas 1/4 cup chopped parsley Parmesan cheese and black pepper to taste steps 1. Heat water, salt, and pasta in the pot until boiling. Reduce to simmer and cook 4 minutes. Drain and reserve cooking water. 1. While pasta is cooking, heat dutch oven or large skillet over medium heat ( 2 minutes). Add oil, when it moves easily across pan, add onion. Cook until onion is softened, approximately 5 7 minutes. 1. Add red pepper and cook until softened, approximately 3 5 minutes. Tear sausage into pieces and add to pot. Cook until no longer pink, approximately 5 minutes. Use a cooking spoon to break into crumbles. 1. Once sausage is cooked, add jar of pasta sauce and frozen peas. Cook 2 3 minutes to combine. 1. Off heat, add chopped parsley, cheese, and black pepper. based on https://altonbrown.com/recipes/cold water pasta method/

title: CHICKEN TIKKA MASALA
content: CHICKEN TIKKA MASALA info About 40 minutes prep, 45 minutes total about 4 servings ingredients 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin 1/2 teaspoon ground coriander 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper 1 teaspoon table salt 2 pounds boneless, skinless chicken breasts 1 cup plain whole milk yogurt 2 tablespoons vegetable oil 2 medium garlic cloves, minced or pressed (about 2 teaspoons) 1 tablespoon grated fresh ginger 3 tablespoons vegetable oil 1 medium onion, diced fine (about 1 1/4 cups) 2 medium garlic cloves, minced or pressed (about 2 teaspoons) 2 teaspoons grated fresh ginger 1 serrano chile, ribs and seeds removed, flesh minced 1 tablespoon tomato paste 1 tablespoon garam masala 1 (28 oz) can crushed tomatoes 2 teaspoons sugar table salt 2/3 cup heavy cream 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves steps 1. Combine cumin, coriander, cayenne, and salt in a small bowl. 1. Sprinkle both sides of the chicken with the spice mixture, pressing gently so the mixture adheres. 1. Place chicken on a plate, cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for 30 60 minutes. 1. In a large bowl, whisk together yogurt, oil, garlic, and ginger; set aside. 1. Heat oil in a large Dutch oven or large pan over medium heat until shimmering. 1. Add onion and cook, stirring frequently, until light golden, 8 10 minutes. 1. Add garlic, ginger, chile, tomato paste, and garam masala; cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 3 minutes. 1. Add crushed tomatoes, sugar, and 1/2 teaspoon salt; bring to a boil. 1. Reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. 1. Stir in cream and return to a simmer. 1. Remove the pan from heat and cover to keep warm. 1. While the sauce simmers, adjust the oven rack to the upper middle position (about 6 inches from the heating element) and heat the broiler. 1. Using tongs, dip the chicken into the yogurt mixture so it is coated with a thick layer of yogurt, then arrange the pieces on a wire rack set in a foil lined rimmed baking sheet or broiler pan. 1. Discard excess yogurt mixture. 1. Broil the chicken until the thickest parts register 160°F on an instant read thermometer and the exterior is lightly charred in spots, 10 18 minutes, flipping halfway through cooking. 1. Let the chicken rest 5 minutes, then cut it into 1 inch chunks and stir into the warm sauce (do not simmer the chicken in the sauce). 1. Stir in cilantro, adjust seasoning with salt, and serve. notes Use whole milk yogurt and heavy cream for a rich, silky sauce. Broiling the chicken gives it a slightly charred exterior without drying it out. based on Original recipe adapted from chicken tikka masala cooking techniques.

title: HUMMUS FATTEH
content: HUMMUS FATTEH info About 30 minutes prep, 1 hour total about 4 servings ingredients 2 cups cooked chickpeas, divided 1/3 cup tahini 1/4 cup fresh lemon juice 2 cloves garlic, minced 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin 1/2 teaspoon salt, plus more to taste 1/3 cup olive oil, divided 4 pita rounds, cut into wedges 8 ounces ground beef or lamb 1 small onion, finely chopped 1 teaspoon ground cumin 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon 1/4 cup pine nuts 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley 1/4 cup plain yogurt (optional) Paprika or Aleppo pepper for garnish steps 1. Preheat the oven to 375°F. Toss pita wedges with 2 tablespoons of olive oil and salt, then spread on a baking sheet and bake until crisp and golden, about 10 minutes. 1. Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add chopped onion and cook until softened. 1. Add ground beef or lamb, cumin, cinnamon, and a pinch of salt. Cook, breaking up the meat, until browned and cooked through. Set aside. 1. In a blender or food processor, combine 1 1/2 cups cooked chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, garlic, cumin, salt, and remaining olive oil. Blend until smooth, adding a little water if needed to reach a creamy consistency. 1. In a small skillet, toast pine nuts over medium heat until lightly browned. Remove and set aside. 1. Arrange toasted pita chips in a shallow serving dish. Spread the hummus on top of the pita, leaving some chips visible. 1. Scatter the remaining chickpeas and cooked meat over the hummus. 1. Drizzle with yogurt if using, sprinkle with toasted pine nuts, chopped parsley, and a dusting of paprika or Aleppo pepper. notes For extra richness, warm the hummus slightly before assembling. You can swap the ground meat for toasted pine nuts alone for a vegetarian version. based on https://www.seriouseats.com/hummus fatteh recipe 8641111

title: 3-INGREDIENT STOVETOP MAC AND CHEESE
content: 3 INGREDIENT STOVETOP MAC AND CHEESE info About 5 minutes prep, 15 minutes total about 4 servings ingredients 8 ounces elbow macaroni 1 1/2 cups evaporated milk 2 cups shredded sharp cheddar cheese steps 1. Bring 4 cups of water to a boil in a medium saucepan. Add the macaroni and cook until just shy of al dente, about 6 minutes. 1. Drain the pasta and return it to the pan. Pour in the evaporated milk and heat over medium low until the liquid is warm. 1. Add the shredded cheddar a handful at a time, stirring constantly until the cheese has melted and the sauce is smooth. 1. Continue cooking gently for 1 to 2 minutes, stirring often, until the pasta is coated and the sauce is thickened. 1. Remove from the heat and let rest briefly before serving. notes Use a good quality sharp cheddar for the best flavor. If the sauce is too thick, add a splash of milk or reserved pasta water. based on https://www.seriouseats.com/ingredient stovetop mac and cheese recipe

title: TURKEY BURGERS
content: TURKEY BURGERS info About 10 minutes prep, 15 minutes total about 4 servings ingredients 1 ¼ pounds 93% lean ground turkey ½ cup whole milk ricotta cheese ½ teaspoon salt ½ teaspoon ground black pepper 2 teaspoons Worcestershire sauce 2 teaspoons Dijon mustard 1 tablespoon vegetable or canola oil 4 hamburger buns and preferred toppings steps 1. Mix ricotta, salt, pepper, Worcestershire sauce, and Dijon mustard gently in a bowl. Once fully combined, add turkey and recombine. 1. Shape the mix into four equal patties, pressing a slight dimple into the center of each. 1. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. 1. Cook patties without moving them until a dark golden crust forms, about 3 to 4 minutes. 1. Flip the burgers, cook until done through, and transfer to buns with your favorite toppings. notes Adding whole milk ricotta to the meat keeps lean turkey moist and tender. based on https://www.americastestkitchen.com/recipes/890 quicker turkey burgers https://www.zestfulkitchen.com/juicy dijon thyme turkey burger recipe/
